{{Top|leg}}
'''Pryss-creatures''' were large, [[Elephant/Legends|elephantine]] beasts found on the primitive [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Verig]]. Verig's [[Unidentified Verig species|native nomadic hunters]] used [[Bola/Legends|bola]]-like weapons while [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] to trip the creatures.

During an expedition to Verig during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] tactician [[Beryl Chiffonage]] observed the planet's nomads' strategy of tripping the Pryss-creatures. Inspired by what he saw, Chiffonage developed his own strategy for use by [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]] to trip and down [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] using a [[Power harpoon launcher|harpoon and tow cable]], a tactic put to effective use by the Rebellion during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
